title: ResearchOS Prediction
description: A pre-registered, scorable prediction about a hypothesis. Registered before the observation is collected, so that a later judgement cannot quietly move the goalposts. Without controlled experiments this is the only mechanism left that keeps a hypothesis falsifiable: the probability makes the claim quantitative, and refutation_condition makes the failure condition explicit in advance. Scored with a Brier score once resolved (docs/2026-10-21_hypothesis-cycle-automation.md sections 3 (S6) and 8.5).

registered_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp; must precede the observation

probability.description: Self-declared probability that the prediction holds, range [0, 1]

statement.description: The observation that is expected, stated so it can be checked

superseded_by.description: prediction_id of the replacement. A prediction is not edited in place; a changed condition is a new record, so the history of goalpost movement stays visible.
